thread:
Maria: Customer (redacted) opened a support ticket — their function/tool call in JSON mode is throwing parse/schema errors and they saw repeated retries and unexpected billing. Pasting minimal repro and runtime error below.

Maria: ```json
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-xyz",
  "input": "Get invoice status for 12345",
  "json_mode": true,
  "functions": [
    {
      "name": "get_invoice",
      "arguments": {"invoiceId": "12345"}
    }
  ]
}
```

Maria: Runtime response: 400 Bad Request, validation error: Missing required key "invoice_id" for function get_invoice; request_id=req_0a1b2c3d; logs show schema validation failed after codegen. Customer insists they followed docs (they used camelCase).

Jamal: Do we have the exact request body from the edge log? any chance the SDK double-encoded arguments (string instead of object)?

Maria: Attached edge log snippet: 
```
edge.req=2767891234 req_id=req_0a1b2c3d body={"model":"open-xyz","functions":[{"name":"get_invoice","arguments":"{\"invoice_id\":12345}"}],"json_mode":true}
```

Maria: So the customer actually sent arguments as a string (stringified JSON) — SDK v2 bug? They think this is equivalent but our schema validator expects an object.

Ryan: Confirming: if arguments is a string we currently treat it as opaque and fail schema validation. We used to have a tolerant parse for earlier clients but removed it during strict-json-mode rollout. That explains the Missing required key error.

Priya: This produced a 400 that the client retried twice, which generated multiple backend calls and billing events. Customer is asking for refund for the extra two successful invocations.

Kaito: Also noticed a latency spike in the same window (p95 -> 2.1s) because the runtime attempted schema coercion then threw. Probably unrelated to infra but adds to user pain.

billing-bot: Noted. Please file a billing refund request with request_ids and timestamps. I'll triage once ticket references are added.

Maria: Repro steps (quick):
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"open-xyz","json_mode":true,"functions":[{"name":"get_invoice","arguments":"{\"invoice_id\":12345}"}]}'
Expect: 400 schema validation error.
Workaround: send arguments as an object: 
-d '{"functions":[{"name":"get_invoice","arguments": {"invoice_id": 12345}}]}'

Jamal: Customer SDK version?

Maria: They were on sdk-js@2.1.0. They upgraded to 2.1.3 in their account test and reported it fixed the issue (release note said it stopped stringifying arguments in certain call paths).

Ryan: Action items:
- Short-term: add a runtime tolerant parser toggle that will attempt to JSON.parse string arguments when json_mode=true and log a warning instead of hard fail (PR in progress, will feature-flag).
- Medium-term: update docs and SDK lint checks to ensure arguments are objects for structured functions.
- Support: confirm refunds for duplicate invocations (Maria + billing).
- Eng/SRE: monitor for similar spikes and correlation with sdk-js 2.x.

Priya: Maria — can you confirm the exact set of request_ids and the customer's account id in the billing ticket? I'll include the p95 spike window for context.

Maria: Done — filed INC-2026-842 with req_ids [req_0a1b2c3d, req_0a1b2c3e, req_0a1b2c3f] and account redacted-678. Billing notified.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-842 created (severity: low) — assigned to Priya and Kaito.

Ryan: I'll open the runtime PR to add the tolerant decode behind a feature flag (will link PR shortly). Long-term we shouldn't silently accept stringified args, but small recovery path needed for existing broken clients.

Maria: Customer confirmed refund request received. Marking thread for follow-up after runtime PR lands. :thumbsup:

Priya: closing loop — will update when billing completes refund and when runtime flag is rolled out.

Kaito: note: add metric to catch "arguments are stringified" to detect other SDKs.

Maria: thanks everyone.
